title: Python reassembly rotation removes the same tombstone twice
description: _AuthenticatedReassemblyManager.rotate_remote calls self._tombstones.pop(key, None) twice consecutively before removing rejection state. The duplicate is harmless but obscures the exact atomic retirement set in security-sensitive cleanup and can hide an omitted registry in future edits. Remove the duplicate and keep an explicit test that rotation clears contexts, tombstones, and rejections for both old/new signers.
